name: Switch
blurb: An on/off control, with an optional icon riding in the knob.
mechanism: A native checkbox, visually hidden but still the control - it keeps focus, keyboard and form submission. The track and knob are a sibling span, so the state rules are plain CSS sibling selectors and there is no JavaScript and no second input to keep in sync.
caveats: A switch is announced as a checkbox. Where it applies immediately rather than on save, say so in the label - the shape carries that meaning for sighted users and nothing else does.
The icon inside the knob is decoration and carries `aria-hidden`. A switch whose only label is its icon has no accessible name; keep the text label.
At 24px the knob is below the 40px touch floor, so the whole row is the label and therefore the hit area. Do not shrink the row to fit the switch.
support: `:has()` — Baseline since December 2023, used only for the pressed state and the disabled cursor.
